title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Venetian Theatre, Las Vegas | 2025
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Venetian Theatre in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA, on 26 September 2025.

It was the 21st show of the 16th All-Starr Band’s 2025 tour. This was the fifth of six tour dates at the Venetian Theatre.

Starr previously performed at the Venetian on 24, 26, and 27 May 2023, and 22, 25, 26, 29, and 31 May and 1 June 2024.

The 16th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Buck Johnson: vocals, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
